title: aide Core Configuration (config.yaml)
description: Global settings stored in ~/.config/aide/config.yaml under the modular split layout.

default_profile.description: Name of the fallback profile used when no profile match rule matches the current directory.

agents.description: Registered coding agent binaries keyed by agent name (e.g. claude, codex, gemini, pi, omp, opencode, agy).

AgentDef.description: Definition of a coding agent binary. Agents carry no environment variables or secrets.

binary.description: Executable name on PATH or absolute path to the agent binary.

icon.description: Optional icon displayed for this agent in banners and statuslines.

Preferences.description: Global display and launch behavior preferences.

show_info.description: Show the startup info banner before launching an agent.

info_style.description: Visual style of the startup info banner.

info_detail.description: Verbosity level of the startup info banner.

yolo.description: Enable agent auto-approve / yolo mode by default.

prompt_gateway.description: Prompt interactively to pick a gateway when launching if multiple gateways are configured.

StatuslineConfig.description: Statusline module ordering and per-module icon/label customization.

order.description: Ordered list of statusline modules to render.

icon.description: Prefix icon for list-style or value-style modules.

on.description: Rendered string when the module state is on.

off.description: Rendered string when the module state is off.

outbound.description: Rendered string for outbound network mode.

unrestricted.description: Rendered string for unrestricted network mode.

untrusted.description: Rendered string when project config is untrusted.

unmanaged.description: Rendered string when running outside aide management.

value.description: Rendered string when a flag-style module is active.
